name: Old Ironforge
summary: Beneath the High Seat, Old Ironforge remains sealed behind guarded gates. Known as the Assembly of Thanes, this ancient chamber lies deep below the royal throne room.

sections.title: The Assembly of Thanes
sections.body: Old Ironforge lies beneath King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat. Its cavernous halls sit deep in the mountain, where winding stone bridges cross pools of lava. Long before the Great Forge and the Commons filled with dwarven commerce, early thanes gathered here to govern the mountain kingdom.

sections.title: A Sealed Chamber
sections.body: The entrance from the throne room remains barred. Ironforge's royal guard watches the thresholds leading down into the old vaults.

faq.answer: Old Ironforge, also called the Assembly of Thanes, is an ancient district beneath Ironforge. Its cavernous halls and lava conduits lie below the modern city.

aliases: how to get into old ironforge
faq.answer: The gates in the High Seat are sealed and guarded by the dwarven royal guard, so ordinary citizens cannot enter through the throne room. Dark Iron maps show tunnels converging at a point beneath Ironforge itself.
The entrance lies inside the High Seat, the royal audience chamber where King Magni Bronzebeard sits in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is Old Ironforge significant to dwarven history?
aliases: why is it called assembly of thanes
faq.answer: The Assembly of Thanes was an ancient meeting ground for dwarven leaders and mountain kings, before the upper rings of the modern mountain capital were fully established.

angles.text: For dwarves, Old Ironforge and the Assembly of Thanes preserve a sacred link to their ancestral roots, in the deepest stone foundations of their mountain realm.
King Magni's guards watch the sealed gates of the High Seat. Anyone caught meddling with the old halls below would face stern dwarven justice.
